Each WatchCircle has a single Jedi Guardian who acts as an Executor, the facilitator who manages logistical details so the WatchCircles can do their job. The Executor is also responsible for reporting the WatchCircle's findings and activities back to
. Executors also operate individually, providing general security for the Covenant. In all cases, these individuals are selected for their inability to use
or other significant precognitive abilities, so that they do not taint or influence the findings of their WatchCircle.
The Covenant Shadows operate at the direction of

When undertaking a mission, the Shadow operates under the Executor's authority, but the Shadow is detached from the Executor's group once the task is complete.
